text:
samir: Security will flip keystore ACLs to deny-by-default in eu-west-2 at 02:00 UTC. Likely to block privatelink traffic from our warmpool. Heads-up.
infra-bot: Scheduled change CHG-20250110-522 by @security: keystore-acl-tighten-euw2 at 2025-01-10T02:00Z.
ana: Which CIDRs? warmpool: 10.23.40.0/22, spot-onboard: 10.23.44.0/24. If blocked, joins will see keystore 403s and onboarding slows.
kevin: Cost impact callout: expect 5-12% regional uplift while warmup churns. Recommend temporary allowlist TTL=3h.
samir: Mitigation plan: 1) TF toggle to add allowlist for those CIDRs with TTL tag, 2) 3-node canary before full ACL, 3) readiness probe fail faster (3 attempts).
ana: I'll open PR `infra/keystore-temp-allow-euw2`, include tfvar allowlist_ttl="3h" and rollback script. PR -> https://git.company/infra/pull/900.
kevin: Monitoring: alarm keystore_5xx > 2% for 5m, warmup_latency > baseline+15% for 10m. Tie to PD.
infra-bot: Temp channel created: #temp/keystore-euw2-preflight.
samir: Preflight test cmd: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "X-Node: canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake` run from bastion at 01:15 UTC. If 403, abort and ask security to exclude privatelink CIDRs.
ana: Agreed. I'll run preflight and coordinate with security. Be on-call 01:00-02:30 UTC.
kevin: Added autoscaler safety: pause large-scale warmups if onboarding latency > 2x baseline for 15m.
samir: Ok closing thread; will update after canary. :white_check_mark:
